chapter: Trent's band: Texas, St. Louis and the road east
title: Lee Hillyard and the George Hudson telegram story
summary: Hillyard plays trumpet and alto; Hudson steals a telegram meant for Roy Eldridge and gets the job instead.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: NOW WHERE DID YOU GET HIM, WHEN DID YOU GET HIM? WAS HE THERE WHEN YOU WERE STILL IN TEXAS? I THOUGHT YOU DIDN'T GET HIM UNTIL YOU CAME BACK DOWN TO TEXAS AGAIN.
That's what I don't exactly remember.
HE'S NOT ON ANY -- I DON'T THINK HE'S ON ANY OF THE PICTURES.

I don't think he's on any picture, not even the one with the overcoat. That's the one with Dan Meyner and DAN MEYNER, I HAVE A PICTURE OF DAN MEYNER, I HAVE A PICTURE OF HILLYARD WITH STUFF STANDING UP IN BUFFALO.
HE WAS PLAYING IN THE TRUMPET SECTION.

NOW HE'S FROM SAN ANTONIO. NOW HE WAS IN THE BAND, HE CAME INTO THE BAND, DIDN'T HE TELL YOU ONE TIME THAT SOMEBODY ELSE WAS SUPPOSED TO COME IN THE BAND BUT EVERYBODY WAS CRAZY ABOUT LEE BECAUSE HE COULD PLAY TRUMPET AND SAX, WAS THAT THE REASON OR WAS THERE SOMEBODY ELSE THEY WERE GETTING IN THE BAND.
No, that happened in the George Hudson case. We were after another trumpet player we thought.

YOU WERE TRYING TO GET ROY ELDRIAGE. HUDSON STOLE THE TELEGRAM. HE DIDN'T GIVE IT TO ROY, HE KEPT IT HIMSELF, AND CAME IN ROY'S PLACE. SO YOU GOT HUDSON INSTEAD. I KNOW ABOUT THAT. THAT I KNOW ABOUT. PHILLIPS TOLD YOU THAT. IN FACT I THINK HUDSON TOLD, I THINK HUDSON ADMITTED IT HIMSELF.
He almost got sent back. I was hoping to have another guy my age, I think he was younger than I. I kept him in the band.
HE WAS NOT A GREAT MUSICIAN WAS HE?
He was a pretty good musician.
